La tesis pierde fuerza si el retorno dep: The thesis weakens if returns depend on uncontracted ancillary revenue, unverified connection dates or guarantees without adequate financial backing.
¿Quién soporta el desvío entre generació: Who bears the difference between generation and delivery? Is there a negative price clause? What happens if the buyer defaults? Do damages cover lost cash or only part of the loss?

Un círculo para pensar antes de comprome: A circle for thinking before committing capital
Inner Circle nace de una convicción: una: Inner Circle starts from a conviction: a sound investment decision needs more than abundant information. It needs a clear thesis, evidence that can be tested and an explicit criterion for recognising when that thesis is no longer valid.
La geopolítica importa cuando altera una: Geopolitics matters when it changes a route, a contract, access to financing or the ability to collect payment. Our editorial work will bridge that distance: from an international event to a company’s margin, its cash needs and the value an investor is willing to pay for it.
El foco estará en empresas, inversores y: Our focus is on businesses, investors and advisers connecting Iberia, Latin America and MENA. These corridors require an understanding of context alongside transaction detail. An expansion opportunity may be commercially attractive yet fragile because of its financing structure, currency exposure or dependence on an authorisation.
Cada comentario mensual formulará una te: Each monthly commentary will set out a thesis, identify its supporting sources and distinguish facts, forecasts and our own interpretation. Scenarios will test decisions; we will not assign probabilities without sufficient evidence. Where evidence is missing, the outstanding question will matter as much as the conclusion.
Este primer número se centra en el coste: This first edition focuses on the cost of resilience. Continued growth does not guarantee preserved margins, liquidity or capacity to distribute cash. Adaptation can succeed while still requiring more inventory, more capital and a different entry price.
Queremos construir una conversación de c: We want to build a thoughtful conversation around these decisions. The most useful contributions will be specific questions: which assumption supports a valuation, which fact is missing before entering a country or which condition should stop an investment. Membership becomes meaningful when it improves those questions and helps test the answers.
Al cierre de octubre, nuestra lectura fa: At October’s close, our reading favours selecting projects for their ability to generate and preserve cash under stress. Trade adaptation and aggregate growth are insufficient to validate an expansion or a valuation. The advantage must survive more expensive energy, demanding financing and imperfect execution.
El WEO de octubre proyecta crecimiento m: The October WEO projects global growth of 3.1% in 2026 and 3.4% in 2027, with global inflation of 4.7% and 4.1%, respectively. These are forecasts based on information available through 1 October, not observed outcomes.
El 29 de octubre, el BCE mantuvo sus tip: On 29 October, the ECB kept its rates unchanged: deposit facility at 2.50%, main refinancing operations at 2.65% and marginal lending facility at 2.90%. It warned of energy-related upside inflation risks and downside growth risks, alongside tighter financial conditions.
El 8 de octubre, la OMC elevó su previsi: On 8 October, the WTO raised its 2026 merchandise trade volume growth forecast to 3.9%, from 1.9% in March, and reduced its services forecast to 3.3%, from 4.8%. The improvement is uneven and receives a significant boost from AI-related goods.
En su declaración de misión del 2 de oct: In its 2 October mission statement, IMF staff projected Mexican growth of 1.5% in 2026 and 1.8% in 2027, subject to external uncertainty. It highlighted infrastructure needs and reduced regulatory uncertainty to support private investment. This is the mission’s assessment, not an Executive Board decision.
El 30 de octubre, el Banco de la Repúbli: On 30 October, Banco de la República kept its policy rate at 12.25%: four votes to hold and three to raise it by 25 basis points. The statement put September’s annual inflation at 6.3% and highlighted the importance of fiscal developments.
1. La continuidad de la actividad puede: 1. Continued activity can conceal a more demanding business
La coexistencia de crecimiento previsto: Forecast growth and energy pressure can coexist without contradiction. A company may retain customers and volumes by contracting alternative routes, financing more inventory or accepting longer collection periods. In that case, sales hold up better than cash. This is our business interpretation of the context, not an estimate by the cited institutions.
Para quien compra una compañía o financi: For an acquirer or expansion financier, the first adjustment belongs in cash flows: margin after energy and logistics, required investment and working capital. Raising the cost of capital indiscriminately while penalising the same risks in cash flows can double-count the impact. Each adjustment should identify the risk it captures and where it is represented.
2. El comercio agregado no demuestra la: 2. Aggregate trade does not prove demand for a project
La revisión de la OMC invita a evitar un: The WTO revision argues against a uniform reading of the cycle. Improving world trade does not establish occupancy of a particular warehouse, demand for a supplier or profitability of a plant. Our approach requires bottom-up evidence: identified customers, contracts, available capacity and unit economics incorporating total landed cost.
En operaciones de nearshoring, el ahorro: In nearshoring transactions, fewer inventory days must be separated from annual operating savings. The initial working capital release helps fund the transition but cannot recur inside EBITDA every year. A project that appears cheap when treating that effect as recurring can change materially in value when the model is corrected.

El diagnóstico de la misión del FMI refu: The IMF mission’s assessment reinforces a practical question: what must be resolved before committing capital? For a Spanish company, we suggest checking electricity connections, water where relevant, permits, site security, supplier capacity and contracted demand. We do not claim all these risks exist in every project; they are checks to resolve through local diligence.
Nuestra preferencia editorial es por una: Our editorial preference is for phased entry: pilot investment, verifiable milestones and expansion conditional on results. Customer proximity can be an advantage, but it must translate into lower total cost, better service or defensible revenue. Forecast macroeconomic growth does not replace that test.

El tipo de política colombiano describe: Colombia’s policy rate describes a demanding monetary environment, but it is not the rate a company will pay and cannot be inserted directly into its WACC. Effective cost depends on currency, maturity, collateral, fees, credit and hedging. Local financing and euro debt must be compared on equivalent cash flows after incorporating currency risk.
Para una filial que cobra en pesos y pag: For a subsidiary collecting pesos and servicing euro debt, depreciation can increase debt service measured in local currency. Before choosing a structure, organise receipts and payments by maturity and assess how much risk can be passed on to customers. Subsidiary accounting profitability and cash distributable to the parent require separate analysis.
No proponemos suspender la inversión int: We are not proposing a halt to international investment. We propose approving it subject to verifiable economic conditions. An asset merits progressing when its commercial advantage becomes cash, financing matches its currency and duration, and a concrete mechanism limits further contributions if execution deviates.
La disciplina de este mes consiste en pr: This month’s discipline is to ask what it costs to keep the business running and who funds that cost. A defensible valuation must explain which margin is sustainable, what cash remains after investment and how much of that cash can actually reach shareholders.
